title: Moving the camera
summary: Pan, zoom and turn the view, and zoom right out to the planet and the star system.
text:
**On a touch screen:** drag the ground to pan, pinch to zoom, and twist or slide two fingers to turn and tilt.

**With a mouse and keyboard:** W A S D or the arrow keys pan (hold Shift to go faster), the wheel zooms toward the pointer, Q and E turn, and right-drag turns and tilts.

The zoom never stops at the ground. Keep zooming out and you climb from your landing site to the whole planet, then to the star system. As you climb, the darkness over land you haven't explored thins, so from orbit your region sits in the planet instead of a dark patch; zoom back in and it's as dark as before. The **Surface**, **Planet** and **System** buttons (or the keys 1, 2 and 3) jump straight there.

- F or Home looks at what you have selected (with nothing selected, the Command Core)
- Tap or drag the radar map to look somewhere else
- Press ? at any time for every key and gesture
